facts.value: Biomedical engineering uses problem-solving techniques and engineering mechanics to solve biology and medicine-based problems.

Modern medicine has given rise to a wide range of novel engineering solutions to these clinical problems – and a Biomedical Engineering degree is your way to help address current clinical problems and diseases.
Biomedical Engineering is a relatively new area of Engineering, but it is the fastest growing area due to increased demand for biology-based engineers from the MedTech Sector.
